ev.q: In a multistate case-control study, consumption of salami was associated with illness.
PulseNet monitored this pattern and detected an increase in the number of isolates in November 2009
As of April 30, 2010, a total of 272 patients from 44 states and the District of Columbia were reported
Case-patients were more likely than controls to report consumption of salami (matched odds ratio [mOR] = 8.0)
Controls were well persons matched to cases by neighborhood.
State and local health departments and CDC conducted a case-control study during January 16--20, 2010.
CDC to begin coordinating a multistate investigation

methods_quotes.q: Controls were well persons matched to cases by neighborhood.
Controls were matched using a reverse address directory protocol.
